What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/cd9376f67191ac00f58fa74a066d69008b2d43e6743af62ee6577911374ff5eb.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(6,4).$
